FUNCTIONS.title: As a Representative Body
FUNCTIONS.body: COA-Z defends and advances the general welfare of its member organizations, ensuring their voices are heard in university-wide decision-making.

FUNCTIONS.title: As an Administrative Body
FUNCTIONS.body: COA-Z advances member organizations' welfare and advocacies, and upholds its rights within university committees such as the Central Assembly and El Consejo Atenista.

FUNCTIONS.title: As an Administrative Body
FUNCTIONS.body: COA-Z streamlines processes and archives relevant data to preserve efficiency in transitions and operations, both for the Council as a whole and for individual member organizations.

FUNCTIONS.title: As a Formative Body
FUNCTIONS.body: COA-Z fosters the enrichment of core competencies, advocacies, and organizational development toward the holistic formation of members and constituents.

FUNCTIONS.title: As a Unitive Body
FUNCTIONS.body: COA-Z provides platforms and fosters purposeful collaboration among member organizations and institutions, within and beyond Ateneo.

FUNCTIONS.title: Through Service
FUNCTIONS.body: COA-Z fulfills its purpose through essential, effective, and adequate support services and initiatives, and as collective representative and liaison to external entities.

PRINCIPLES.title: Representative Democracy
PRINCIPLES.body: All Ateneo student organizations are present and united in creating a collaborative community that develops student leaders to become empowered, active, competent, and holistically formed.

PRINCIPLES.title: Equality and Accessibility
PRINCIPLES.body: All Ateneo student organizations and their constituents receive fair and equal treatment, and benefit from and with each other in order to form a progressive and effective coalition.

PRINCIPLES.title: Transparency and Accountability
PRINCIPLES.body: All Ateneo student organizations are held fully responsible for decisions that impact the community, with no exemptions.

PURPOSES.title: Represent
PURPOSES.body: Advocate for the welfare, interests, and voices of accredited student organizations within the university.

PURPOSES.title: Support
PURPOSES.body: Provide guidance, administrative assistance, and essential resources that strengthen organizational operations.

PURPOSES.title: Develop
PURPOSES.body: Promote leadership formation, organizational growth, and the continuous development of student leaders.

PURPOSES.title: Connect
PURPOSES.body: Create opportunities for collaboration among organizations, university offices, and external partners.
